mapper.sql: select s.id, s.order_id, s.order_no, s.binding_id, s.parent_id, s.parent_user_id, s.tutor_id, s.tutor_user_id, s.service_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.hours, s.gross_amount, s.commission_amount, s.net_amount, s.status, s.finish_time, s.finish_remark, s.confirm_time, s.confirm_remark, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, p.name as parent_name, p.subject as parent_subject, p.grade as parent_grade, p.location as location, ui.real_name as real_name, ui.real_name as tutor_name from tutoring_schedule s left join parents p on p.id = s.parent_id left join user_info ui on ui.id = s.tutor_user_id
